title: Caveat Override Event Cross-Org Export Envelope (Wakir Federation 1)
description: JSON Schema for the cross-org export envelope of an ExportedCaveatOverrideEvent (Phase-2 Sprint-9 Tag-1, surface at wirelang.federation.caveat_override_export.ExportedCaveatOverrideEvent). The schema admits the pseudonymised envelope only: raw free-form fields (override_reason, original_caveat_set, narrowed_caveat_set) are forbidden at the wire level (defence-in-depth against accidental cross-org narrative leak). Schema-registry id: 'wakir.federation.caveat-override-event-export/1'. OTS-anchored under wirelang/specs/schema-registry-spec.md §5.19 (Phase-2 Sprint-9 Tag-2 v0.34.0). SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

schema.description: Schema discriminator. Pinned to v1; any future bump emits a new $id and a new envelope shape, never a silent overlay.

route_id.description: Federation route identifier. Already federation surface; not pseudonymised. URI-safe ASCII subset (mirrors Sprint-7 peer_org predicate alphabet).

sequence_number.description: Monotonic per-(route_id, original_caveat_chain_hash) sequence-number. Replay-protection axis: a verifier MUST reject any envelope whose sequence_number is not strictly greater than the last seen for the pair. Sentinel 0 is reserved for 'no prior export'.

event_at.description: RFC-3339 UTC timestamp of the original CaveatOverrideEvent. Timing-only field; retained raw because it carries no operator narrative.

exported_at.description: RFC-3339 UTC timestamp of the export. Timing-only field; NOT included in the override_event_id payload so re-exporting at the same sequence_number produces a byte-equal id.

override_event_id.description: BLAKE2b-256 hex (32 bytes) over the JCS-canonical envelope payload: schema, route_id, sequence_number, event_at, chain-hashes, classification surfaces, audit_trace, sorted cross_org_witnesses. Stable audit-leaf identifier.

original_caveat_chain_hash.description: BLAKE2b-256 hex route-scoped pseudonym of the pre-override caveat chain. Equality-comparable, not reversible. Null permitted only when the override targeted an empty caveat set.

narrowed_caveat_chain_hash.description: BLAKE2b-256 hex route-scoped pseudonym of the post-override caveat chain. Equality-comparable, not reversible. Null permitted only when the narrowed set is empty.

narrowing_class.description: Structural narrowing class. Computed by frozen-set comparison over (predicate, args) pairs of the pre/post caveat-sets. Purely structural — no free-form text reveal.

reason_class.description: Categorical operator gesture. The raw override_reason text is stripped at the wire boundary; only this closed enumeration appears in the export.

override_reason_hash.description: BLAKE2b-256 hex route-scoped pseudonym of the operator override_reason text. Equality-comparable, not reversible. Optional — null when the operator supplied no reason (reason_class=UNSPECIFIED) or when the exporter is configured to suppress the hash.

peer_trust_domain.description: SPIFFE-style trust-domain identifier of the peer.

observed_at.description: RFC-3339 UTC timestamp of the witness observation.

cross_org_witnesses.description: Canonical-sorted tuple of cross-org witnesses. The sort order is byte-deterministic so the override_event_id is stable under order-invariant input.

wat_anchor_manifest_id.description: WAT-Layer-4 anchor manifest id binding this trace entry to the Bitcoin-anchored audit trail.

event_kind.description: Audit-trace event kind. Strictly classification — operator outcome_reason text is NOT carried (defence-in-depth).

event_at.description: RFC-3339 UTC timestamp of the audit-trace entry.

audit_trace.description: Structural projection of the underlying audit trace. Free-form outcome_reason narrative is stripped.
